aboutPageSubtitle: Your authentic home in the heart of Northern Nigeria and the Sahel.
aboutWhoBody: Arewa Stay was born from a desire to showcase the beauty and diversity of Northern Nigeria and the wider Sahel. We are a team passionate about culture, technology, and community, dedicated to creating memorable travel stories.
aboutMissionBody: To connect travelers with the rich culture and warm hospitality of the Arewa region by providing a platform for unique, authentic stays — empowering local hosts and giving guests a genuine experience.
aboutVisionBody: To be the leading platform for cultural tourism in the Sahel, fostering economic growth and preserving heritage by making the authentic Arewa experience accessible to the world.
